blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Biological visual systems achieve continuous, low-latency motion perception by processing sparse, asynchronous spiking signals, enabling real-time tracking under strict energy constraints. Event-based cameras, inspired by the mammalian retina, replicate this efficiency by capturing only local brightness changes as asynchronous events, offering a natural substrate for spiking neural networks (SNNs) to parallelise computation and adapt to fast-changing scenes. Pinball provides a controlled yet dynamic testbed, requiring precise motion estimation and fast reaction to a small, rapidly moving target. This work presents a fully spiking, real-time perception-to-action pipeline for closed-loop pinball gameplay. A dynamic vision sensor observes a small, fast-moving ball, and a network of spiking Time-Difference Encoders deployed on the SpiNNaker neuromorphic platform jointly estimates its position, speed, and direction. The system is characterised across receptive field size, accumulation window, and angular tuning width for real-time operation, and benchmarked in closed loop against human players across two flipper regimes of increasing physical realism. The system achieves a hit rate of 56.1 % 56.1\% , nearly double the human average, while reacting within 21.7 ​ ms 21.7\,\mathrm{ms} (with 5 ​ ms 5\,\mathrm{ms} network latency) and consuming an estimated 148 ​ μ ​ W 148\,\mu\mathrm{W} of dynamic power using fewer than 25 25\, k neurons. In the benchmark comparison, it ranks among the fastest and most energy-efficient event-based closed-loop neuromorphic-perception-to-action demonstrators. Under more physically realistic flipper dynamics, the system is able to reproduce the full spectrum of human play styles, from cautious to aggressive, by tuning a single interpretable policy parameter, with no change to the perception pipeline. A physical real-time demonstrator, in which a real ball is tracked and real flippers are actuated in closed loop, confirms that the same perception-to-action principle operates beyond simulation. Its fully spiking, learning-free design ensures reliable, low-latency motion estimation, making it a compact and energy-efficient example of closed-loop, real-time neuromorphic perception-to-action systems.
blocks.zh: 生物视觉系统通过处理稀疏,同步闪烁的信号,实现连续,低纬度运动感知,在严格的能量限制下实现实时跟踪. 基于事件的摄像头在哺乳动物视网膜的启发下,通过只捕捉局部亮度变化作为同步事件来复制这种效率,为溢出神经网络(SNNs)提供一个自然基质,以并行计算并适应快速变化的场景. 弹珠提供可控但动态的试验床,需要精确的运动估计和对一个小的,快速移动的目标的快速反应. 这部作品为闭路弹球游戏提供了全速的实时感知至动作管道. 动态视觉传感器观测到一个快速移动的小球,以及部署在Spinnaker神经形态平台上的闪烁时差编码器网络,共同估计其位置、速度和方向。 该系统具有可接受字段大小、积聚窗口和角调宽度的特点,用于实时操作,并以封闭循环的方式与人类玩家进行基准对比,跨越两个不断增强的实体现实主义制度。 系统达到56.1%的命中率56.1\%,几乎是人类平均值的两倍,同时在21.7 ms 21.7\,\mathrm{ms}(与5 ms 5\,\mathrm{ms}网络空闲)范围内反应,并消耗约148 μ W 148\,\mu\mathrm{W}使用不到25 25\, k神经元的动态功率. 在基准比较中,它属于速度最快、能效最高的事件封闭式神经形态感知对行动的示威者。 在更物理现实的翻转动力学下,系统能够通过调制单一可解释的政策参数来复制人类游戏风格的全谱,从谨慎到攻击,没有改变感官管道. 一个物理实时的演示器,其中真实的球被跟踪,真实的翻转器在闭环中被激活,证实同样的感知对动作原理在运作上超出了模拟. 它的完全振荡,无学习设计确保了可靠,低纬度的运动估计,使其成为紧凑和节能的闭锁-loop,实时神经形态感知-动作系统的例子.

blocks.en: Figure 1: The closed neuromorphic-perception-to-action (nPA) loop for real-time pinball gameplay. The pinball simulator (PinballSim) runs on the host PC and is displayed on a monitor, where a Prophesee EVK4-HD event camera records a 128 × 128 128\times 128 region of interest around the flippers and drain. The resulting event stream is processed by the spiking-based pinball (sP) network on SpiNNaker: after input accumulation and denoising, a segmentation stage groups the filter map into receptive fields feeding eight direction-selective (TDE) populations, which encode local motion; these project to a readout population that estimates motion direction and speed, while ball position is read from the filter map. The resulting state vector ( x , y , v , ϕ ) (x,y,v,\phi) is passed to the host-side strike policy, which issues the left/right flipper commands that close the loop.
blocks.zh: 图 1:闭塞神经形态-感知-动作(nPA)循环用于实时弹球游戏. 弹球模拟器(PinballSim)运行在主机PC上,并在显示器上显示,其中预言EVK4-HD事件摄像头记录了在翻转器和排水管周围的128×128128\时的128区域. 由此产生的事件流由Spinnaker上基于sping的弹球(sP)网络进行处理:在输入累积和解诺后,一个分解阶段将滤波图分组为可接受字段,供8个方向选择性(TDE)人群使用,它们编码了局部运动;这些项目提供给一个读出人口,用于估计运动方向和速度,而球位置则从滤波图读取. 由此产生的状态矢量(x,y,v,φ) (x,y,v,\phi)被传递到主机端的打击政策上,由主机端发布左/右翻转命令关闭循环.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The detection of rapid motion and accurate estimation of object velocity constitute fundamental prerequisites for downstream tasks such as object tracking, activity recognition, and collision avoidance in dynamic scene understanding. Consequently, a large and growing body of research in computer vision has leveraged advances in machine learning and deep learning to address these challenges, achieving high accuracy across edge and embedded applications ranging from autonomous driving and industrial automation to elderly fall detection and surveillance systems [ 69 , 37 , 72 ] .
Despite their impressive accuracy, conventional approaches rely on traditional frame-based cameras that process all pixels in every frame, including redundant regions that remain unchanged. For edge and embedded systems with limited memory, power, and compute resources, this leads to unnecessary energy consumption [ 66 , 24 ] . Moreover, frame-based sensors inherently face a latency–bandwidth trade-off and often struggle under fast motion, low light, or high dynamic range conditions, where motion blur, poor contrast, and limited dynamic range degrade detection reliability [ 78 , 79 , 11 , 29 , 45 ] .
blocks.zh:
快速运动的探测和对物体速度的准确估计是下游任务的基本先决条件,如物体跟踪、活动识别和动态场景理解中避免碰撞。 因此,计算机视觉方面的大量和不断增长的研究利用了机器学习和深入学习方面的进展来应对这些挑战,实现了跨越边缘的高精度和嵌入式应用,从自主驾驶和工业自动化到老年人秋季探测和监视系统[69、37、72]。
常规方法尽管精度令人印象深刻,但依靠传统的帧式相机处理每个帧中的所有像素,包括没有变化的冗余区域. 对于内存、功率和计算资源有限的边缘和嵌入式系统,这会导致不必要的能源消耗[66、24]。 此外,基于帧的传感器内在面对一个缓冲-波段宽度权衡,常常在快速运动、低光或高动态射程条件下挣扎,其中运动模糊、对比差和有限的动态射程会降低探测可靠性[78、79、11、29、45]。

blocks.en: In contrast, biological visual systems achieve continuous motion processing with remarkable efficiency. Inspired by biological processes, neuromorphic vision sensors have emerged as promising alternatives to conventional frame-based cameras [ 29 , 44 ] . Unlike traditional sensors that capture frames at fixed rates, Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS) encode pixel-level brightness changes as asynchronous events with microsecond-level temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and minimal latency [ 44 , 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 相比之下,生物视觉系统以显著的效率实现了连续的运动处理. 在生物过程的启发下,神经形态视觉传感器已成为传统帧式相机的有希望的替代品[29,44]. 与以固定速率捕获帧的传统传感器不同,动态视星等传感器(Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS))编码像素水平亮度变化为具有微秒时间分辨率,高动态范围,以及最小潜伏度的同步事件[44,20].

blocks.en:
Recent work on event-based motion estimation focused on optical flow, typically building dense flow fields rather than local, cell-specific detectors. Benosman et al. [ 13 , 5 ] made significant contributions in this direction, introducing event-driven flow formulations and asynchronous feature methods.
More recently, Bardow et al. [ 4 ] proposed the first simultaneous intensity and flow estimation framework, and later Zhu et al. [ 81 ] presented EV-FlowNet, a deep-learning model trained end-to-end on events. The development of large-scale event datasets such as MVSEC [ 80 ] and DSEC [ 32 ] further accelerated progress in motion estimation and evaluation. Other recent work from Gao et al. [ 30 ] focuses on contrast-maximisation–based optimisation methods for the estimation of optical flow, evaluating the method in several public object tracking scenarios. While these methods achieve rich visual motion representations, they typically require offline training, large memory footprints, or computationally expensive processing, failing to exploit the inherent sparsity and efficiency of biologically plausible spiking-based neuromorphic systems.
blocks.zh:
最近关于事件运动估计的工作侧重于光学流,一般是建立密集的流场,而不是局部的,细胞特有的探测器. Benosman等人[13,5]在这方面做出了重大贡献,引入了事件驱动的流配方和同步特征方法.
最近,Bardow等人著。 [4]提出了第一个同步强度和流量估计框架,后来的朱等. [81] 介绍了EV-FlowNet,这是一个深层学习模式,对事件的端对端进行了培训。 MVSEC[80]和DSEC[32]等大型事件数据集的开发进一步加快了运动估计和评价方面的进展. Gao等人最近的其他著作。 [30] 注重对比-最大-基于光学流估计的优化方法,在几种公共物体跟踪情景中评价该方法. 虽然这些方法能够实现丰富的视觉运动表现,但它们通常需要离线训练、巨大的记忆足迹或计算成本昂贵的处理,未能利用生物上可能存在的振荡神经形态系统的内在伸缩和效率。

blocks.en: Meanwhile, biological vision systems exhibit efficient direction selectivity much earlier in the processing pipeline, as early as retinal ganglion cells [ 71 ] , followed by specialised motion analysis in cortical areas MT/V5 and MST [ 75 , 7 ] . These neurons exploit sparse, asynchronous spiking signals to encode motion direction, velocity, and object trajectories with remarkable computational efficiency, processing only changes in the visual scene via temporal contrast rather than dense pixel grids [ 26 , 9 ] . This biologically plausible approach enables low-latency, low-power parallel computation critical for real-time survival tasks like pursuit and tracking [ 51 ] , unlike the continuous, memory-intensive representations of event-based deep networks.
blocks.zh: 同时,生物视觉系统更早在加工管道中显示出有效的方向选择性,最早是视网膜断层细胞[71],然后是皮质区MT/V5和MST[75,7]的专门运动分析。 这些神经元利用稀疏,同步的振荡信号编码运动方向,速度,以及具有显著计算效率的物体轨迹,只通过时间对比处理视觉场景的变化,而不是密集像素网格[26,9]. 这种生物学上可行的方法使得低相关性,低功率的并行计算对追求和跟踪等实时生存任务至关重要[51],与基于事件的深层网络的连续,内存密集的表示不同.

blocks.en:
Motion perception in artificial visual systems has been strongly inspired by biological models of early vision [ 49 , 9 , 74 ] . Drawing on direction selectivity in biological systems, early foundational work, such as the Hassenstein–Reichardt detector [ 40 ] and subsequent extensions by Borst and Egelhaaf [ 8 ] , established the concept of correlation-based Elementary Motion Detectors (EMDs) as the simplest mechanism for computing local motion through spatiotemporal correlation. In parallel, the spatiotemporal energy model from Adelson and Bergen [ 1 ] offered a different computational basis for motion direction selectivity, shaping motion direction detection by measuring energy from filters tuned to specific spatiotemporal patterns in visual inputs. Later, Borst and Euler [ 10 ] refined the classic Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator [ 40 ] into a canonical model for correlator-based motion perception using elementary motion detectors (EMDs) in fly visual circuits. Their work [ 10 ] incorporated ON/OFF signal segregation to explain flicker suppression and contrast invariance.
Further studies in Drosophila have later uncovered specialised small-target–selective and object-detecting neurons, inspiring artificial mechanisms for attention, feature selection, and object tracking in neuromorphic systems [ 76 ] .
blocks.zh:
人工视觉系统中的运动感知受到早期视觉的生物模型[49,9,74]的强烈启发. 借鉴生物系统的方向选择性,早期的基础工作,如Hassenstein–Reichardt探测器[40]和后来的Borst和Egelhaaf[8]的扩展,确立了基于相关性的初级运动探测器(EMDs)的概念,作为通过瞬间相关性计算局部运动的最简单机制. 与此同时,来自Adelson和Bergen[1]的spatiotemporal能量模型为运动方向选择性提供了不同的计算基础,通过测量视觉输入中从调制的滤波器到特定spatiotoral的能量来塑造运动方向检测. 后来,Borst和Euler[10]将经典的Hassenstein-Reichardt关联器[40]精制成在飞行视觉电路中使用初级运动探测器(EMDs)的基于关联器的运动感知的犬形模型. 他们的工作[10]纳入了ON/OFF信号隔离,以解释闪烁抑制和反射偏差。
Drosophila的进一步研究后来发现了专门的小型目标——选择性和物体探测神经元,激发了神经形态系统中的人工注意机制、特征选择和物体跟踪[76]。

blocks.en:
While these bio-inspired models capture the efficiency of biological motion detection, most conventional implementations process dense frame-based inputs rather than sparse asynchronous events from neuromorphic sensors. They are also typically executed on traditional digital computing architectures, limiting the benefits of event-driven processing.
Neuromorphic hardware [ 22 ] , including both analog [ 53 , 48 , 56 ] and digital platforms [ 27 , 16 , 64 ] , addresses these limitations by integrating memory and computation. This architecture avoids the von Neumann bottleneck and supports highly parallel, event-driven processing. On such platforms, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) efficiently process asynchronous event streams [ 21 , 65 , 33 , 52 ] , enabling low-latency and energy-efficient real-time operation [ 25 , 23 ] . Their event-driven operation reduces data movement and power consumption. Platforms such as SpiNNaker [ 28 , 41 ] , Loihi [ 16 ] , and FPGA-based systems [ 50 , 62 ] enable efficient real-time motion processing with event-based sensors [ 25 , 23 , 35 ] .
blocks.zh:
虽然这些受到生物启发的模型能够捕捉到生物运动探测的效率,但大多数常规执行会处理密集的帧式输入,而不是从神经形态传感器中稀少的同步事件. 它们也通常在传统的数字计算架构上执行,限制了事件驱动处理的好处.
神经形态硬件[22],包括模拟[53,48,56]和数字平台[27,16,64],通过整合内存和计算来解决这些局限性. 这种架构避免了冯·诺伊曼瓶颈,支持高度平行,事件驱动的处理. 在这些平台上,Spiking神经网络(SNNs)高效地处理同步事件流[21,65,33,52],使低纬度和节能实时运行[25,23]成为可能. 他们的事件驱动操作减少了数据移动和电力消耗. Spinnaker [28,41],Loihi [16],以及基于FPGA的系统[50,62]等平台,能够对事件传感器进行高效的实时运动处理[25,23,35].

blocks.en:
Early neuromorphic motion-processing systems focused on local motion estimation using variants of the Reichardt correlator, enabling direction selectivity and velocity estimation from event streams [ 34 , 5 ] . These approaches were primarily applied to robotics tasks such as navigation and obstacle avoidance [ 34 , 43 ] .
More recent work has extended neuromorphic motion detection beyond classical Reichardt correlators. Milde et al. [ 47 ] introduced the spiking Elementary Motion Detector (sEMD), providing a fully spike-based implementation of delay-correlator motion sensing. This principle was later generalised to multi-point Temporal Difference Encoder (TDE) frameworks [ 77 ] . Gutierrez-Galan et al. [ 38 ] proposed a digital TDE model and demonstrated efficient FPGA implementations for several localisation and navigation tasks. Other studies explored biologically inspired extensions, including eccentricity-dependent motion detection [ 23 ] and the emergence of direction selectivity through adaptive synaptic delays [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh:
早期的神经形态运动处理系统侧重于利用Reichardt对流体的变体进行局部运动估计,使方向具有选择性,并从事件流中进行速度估计[34,5]. 这些办法主要适用于导航和障碍避险等机器人任务[34、43]。
近期的作品将神经形态运动探测扩展到了古典的Reichardt关联器之外. 米尔德等人. [47] 引入了尖锐的初级运动探测器(sEMD),提供了一种完全基于尖锐的延迟-辐射器运动感知的应用. 这一原则后来被概括为多点时间差异编码器框架[77]。 Gutierrez-Galan 等人[38]提出了数字TDE模型,并展示了一些定位和导航任务的高效FPGA实施. 其他研究探索了生物启发的扩展,包括偏心依赖运动检测[23]和通过适应性突触延迟出现方向选择性[36].

blocks.en:
Previous EMD/TDE studies typically evaluate direction selectivity using large moving bars, drifting gratings, or wide-field stimuli, which activate broad regions of the sensor. Consequently, they mainly assess coarse left-right or up-down selectivity rather than precise spatial localisation. Obstacle-gap detection in cluttered scenes is a case in point, where many neurons are activated simultaneously, and individual receptive fields (RFs) are rarely probed in isolation [ 34 , 23 , 63 ] . Studies using small moving targets [ 18 ] fare little better, as evaluation still centers on global response consistency or preferred-direction estimation, not on precise tracking of small objects across space.
Taking inspiration from previous implementations [ 63 , 23 , 47 ] , this work evaluates motion selectivity under local activation. Only a small subset of RFs is active as a target moves across the field of view, providing a stricter test of local motion encoding than the wide-field stimuli discussed above.
The pinball game represents a controlled toy problem for this class of tasks: real-world sensorimotor scenarios, such as tracking small, fast-moving objects for collision avoidance or interactive robotic control, similarly demand precise local motion and trajectory estimation from sparse activation, rather than coarse directional classification.
Such problems have been pursued more broadly by the event-based community, including robotic goalkeeping [ 19 , 12 ] and high-speed ball catching [ 73 ] , closed-loop play of the Atari Pong game [ 6 , 58 ] and its physical, higher-dimensional counterpart, air hockey [ 31 , 3 , 2 ] , as well as balancing tasks such as pencil balancing [ 15 ] .
Most exploit event-based sensing, and several additionally process the events with spiking neural networks [ 12 , 82 , 6 , 58 , 3 , 2 ] ; however, only a few combine event-camera input, spiking-based processing, and deployment on neuromorphic hardware in a closed loop [ 12 , 3 ] .
The proposed spiking-based pinball (sP) network falls into this last category, fully neuromorphic, spike-driven, and running on-chip in low-power closed-loop control, while additionally targeting fine-grained motion estimation from local receptive fields activation.
blocks.zh:
以往的EMD/TDE研究通常利用大型移动条、漂移的栅栏或广域刺激来评价方向选择性,这些刺激激活传感器的广泛区域。 因此,它们主要评估粗糙的左偏右或上下偏右,而不是精确的空间定位。 在杂乱无章的场景中,丑陋的-gap探测就是一个例子,许多神经元同时被激活,个别的可接受域(RF)很少在隔离中被探测[34,23,63]. 使用小移动目标的研究[18]的成绩好不到哪里去,因为评价仍然集中于全球反应的一致性或偏好方向估计,而不是精确跟踪跨空间的小物体。
这项工作借鉴了以前的执行[63,23,47],评价了局部激活下的运动选择性. 只有一小部分RF作为靶子跨视场移动而活跃,对局部运动编码的测试比上文讨论的广域刺激更严格.
弹球游戏代表了这一类任务的受控玩具问题:现实世界的感应器情景,如跟踪小型的,快速移动的物体以避免碰撞或交互式机器人控制,同样要求精确的局部运动和轨道估计来自稀疏的激活,而不是粗糙的方向分类.
以事件为主的社区更广泛地追求这些问题,包括机器人守门[19,12]和高速球抓住[73],Atari Pong游戏的闭路游戏[6,58]及其物理,高维对应,空中曲棍球[31,3,2],以及平衡铅笔平衡[15]等任务.
多数利用基于事件的感知,还有几种利用振荡神经网络处理事件[12、82、6、58、3、2];然而,只有少数几种结合事件-摄像头输入、振荡处理和在闭环中部署神经形态硬件[12、3]。
拟议的以弹球(sP)为基础的弹球网络属于最后一个类别,完全具有神经形态,由螺钉驱动,在低功率闭路控制下运行芯片,同时从局部接受球场的激活中进一步针对精细的磨损运动估计.

blocks.en: Building on our prior work on event-based motion processing [ 25 , 23 ] , the proposed work extends SNN-based motion processing to a controlled yet dynamic pinball environment, relying on spike-based EMD frameworks in which TDE units form the basic computation block [ 47 , 63 ] . A standard pinball machine provides a highly dynamic and noisy visual environment. Fast motion, flashing lights, and mechanical elements generate dense event streams. These factors make reliable tracking difficult under strict latency and energy constraints. To the best of the authors’ knowledge, this is the first TDE-based SNN that (i) extracts fine-grained angular motion from sparse activations, (ii) estimates velocity and direction jointly in real time, and (iii) demonstrates closed-loop control in a dynamic pinball system. The main contributions are summarised as follows:
blocks.zh: 根据我们先前关于基于事件的运动处理[25,23]的工作,拟议工作将基于SNN的运动处理扩展到一个可控但动态的弹球环境,依靠基于突起的EMD框架,其中TDE单位构成基本的计算区块[47,63]. 一种标准的弹球机提供了高度动态和吵闹的视觉环境. 快速运动,闪光灯和机械元素产生密集的事件流. 这些因素使得在严格的延迟和能源限制下难以可靠地追踪。 据作者所知,这是第一个基于TDE的SNN,它(一) 从稀疏的激活中提取精细的角运动,(二) 实时估计速度和方向,(三) 在动态弹球系统中显示闭路控制。 主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • A configurable, physics-based pinball simulator and event-acquisition pipeline, comprising a minimal variant with ground-truth position and velocity for controlled system characterisation, an interactive variant with two flipper regimes for closed-loop evaluation, and an adaptive event-count packaging (AECP) strategy that mitigates motion-induced blur at high speed while avoiding excessive latency at low speed. • A neuromorphic motion-detection architecture, in which local Time Difference Encoders (TDEs) [ 47 , 14 , 46 , 39 ] interact through eight directional pathways and project to a continuous 36-neuron angular readout layer for fine-grained motion estimation, implemented entirely through structured spiking computation with no learned or trained parameters, and fully deployed on the SpiNNaker neuromorphic platform for real-time, on-board motion decoding from raw DVS events. • Benchmarking of the resulting latency and power figures against prior event-based closed-loop demonstrators (Table 8 ), showing the system to be competitive with, and in several cases faster or more energy-efficient than, existing neuromorphic sensorimotor systems. • Quantitative benchmarking of the closed-loop system against human players, achieving a hit rate more than double the human average in the binary-gate regime, and showing, in the solid-flipper regime, that a single decision-policy parameter reproduces the full spectrum of human play styles, from cautious to aggressive, without modifying the perception pipeline. • Validation of the approach beyond simulation with a physical demonstrator, in which a real metal ball is tracked by the DVS, processed by the SNN, and used to actuate physical flippers in closed loop, confirming that the same perception-to-action principle operates on real-world hardware.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
The proposed neuromorphic-perception-to-action loop (nPA), illustrated in Figure 1 , operates as a closed-loop architecture that couples event-based perception to pinball game control. It comprises two functional stages. In the first, fully spiking-based perception stage, a DVS camera captures the ball in motion across the simulated pinball playfield, using a custom, open-source pinball simulator (PinballSim) developed for this work 1 1 1 Further information about the Data and Code Availability in Section 8 , and the resulting events are streamed in real time to a spiking neural model (sP network) running on the SpiNNaker neuromorphic platform. The sP network processes the raw event stream to derive an estimate of the ball’s state vector ( x , y , v , ϕ ) (x,y,v,\phi) , where ( x , y ) (x,y) denotes the detected ball position, v v is the estimated speed, and ϕ \phi is the motion direction. The resulting state estimate is then passed to the second, decision-making stage, where strike policy maps it to a control command for flipper actuation. The model processes these raw event streams to extract motion features, estimate the ball’s velocity vector, and generate control decisions that are translated into commands for actuating the flippers.

blocks.en: 2.1 Input acquisition
blocks.zh: 2.1 获取投入

blocks.en: The perception stage begins with generating and capturing the visual stimulus that drives the sP network. This is achieved in two steps: a custom pinball simulator renders the game and provides ground-truth position and velocity for evaluation (Section 2.1.1 ), while a DVS camera observes this rendered scene and converts it into the accumulated event packages that form the network’s raw input (Section 2.1.2 ).
blocks.zh: 感知阶段始于生成和捕捉驱动sP网络的视觉刺激. 这是通过两个步骤实现的:一个自定义的弹球模拟器制作游戏,并提供地面真实位置和评价速度(第2.1.1节),而一个DVS相机观测到这个已经形成的场景并将其转换成构成网络原始输入的累积事件包(第2.1.2节)。

blocks.en: 2.1.1 The pinball game simulator: PinballSim
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 国家 弹球游戏模拟器:弹球Sim

blocks.en: A DVS camera produces the event-based input by observing a custom, physics-based pinball simulator (PinballSim) rendered on a monitor. It provides a reproducible, configurable environment for studying motion perception and closed-loop control. Two versions of PinballSim are implemented: a simplified minimal game simulator , used to calibrate the acquisition pipeline and model parameters, and a complete interactive pinball game simulator , used for closed-loop evaluation (see Figure 2 ). The interactive version additionally implements two flipper regimes, binary-gate and solid flipper. PinballSim is implemented using the Pygame library [ 55 ] 2 2 2 https://github.com/pygame/pygame and records the ball’s position and velocity to generate ground truth (the link to the code can be found in Section 8 ).
blocks.zh: 一台DVS相机通过观察一个自定义的,基于物理学的弹球模拟器(PinballSim)在显示器上渲染而产生基于事件的输入. 它为研究运动感知和闭路控制提供了可复制,可配置的环境. PinballSim有两个版本被实施:一个简化的最小游戏模拟器,用于校准收购管道和模型参数,另一个完整的交互式弹球游戏模拟器,用于闭路评价(见图2). 交互式版本额外执行两个翻转器制度,二进制门和固态翻转器. PinballSim是使用Pygame库[55] 2 2 2 https://github.com/pygame/pygame执行的,并记录球的位置和生成地面真理的速度(与代码的链接可见于第8节).

blocks.en:
The minimal game simulator version of the game was designed for system characterisation purposes and preserves the essential motion dynamics of pinball while deliberately removing unnecessary visual and mechanical complexity, such as reflections and moving objects. In this controlled configuration, the ball moves exclusively along predefined trajectories. Linear motion is generated along eight discrete directions (0°, 45°, 90°, …, 315°)
to systematically evaluate the sensitivity and selectivity of eight direction-selective populations within the spiking-based pinball network (Section 2.2 ), as well as their ability to estimate the speed and direction of motion. In addition, a circular trajectory of the ball, executed in both clockwise and counter-clockwise directions, is used to assess the behaviour of sP’s angular readout population (For further details, see Section 2.2 and Figure 1 ), validating its capacity to produce a continuous angle representation over a full 360° motion cycle.
blocks.zh:
游戏的最小游戏模拟器版本是为系统字符化目的设计的,并保留了弹球的基本运动动力,同时有意去除不必要的视觉和机械复杂性,如反射和移动物体. 在这种受控配置中,球完全沿着预先定义的轨迹运动. 线性运动沿着八个离散方向(0°,45°,90°,.,315°)生成.
系统地评估以弹球为主的弹球网(第2.2节)内八个定向选择性人群的敏感性和选择性,以及他们估计运动速度和方向的能力。 此外,采用顺时针方向和逆时针方向执行的球的圆形轨迹来评估SP的角读出群的行为(详见第2.2节和图1),验证其在全360°运动周期内产生连续角表示的能力.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Pinball simulator variations. a) Minimal game simulator, in which the ball follows predefined trajectories used to characterise the spiking-based pinball network. b) Ball-speed profile in the minimal simulator: constant speeds from 0 to 1000 px/s, stepped in 100 px/s increments and held for 1 s each, repeated over successive cycles. c) Interactive game simulator, a fully playable environment used for closed-loop evaluation.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 弹球模拟器变化。 (a) 国家 最小游戏模拟器,其中球遵循预先定义的轨迹,用于描述以弹球为主的弹球网络. (b) 财务 最低模拟器中的球速剖面:恒定速度从0到1000px/s,在100px/s增量中踩踏,并保持每秒1s,连续周期重复. (c) 国家 交互式游戏模拟器(Interactive game simulator),一种用于闭路评价的完全可玩环境.

blocks.en: The interactive game simulator (Figure 2 C) extends the minimal version into a full playable environment, restoring the visual and mechanical complexity omitted during the characterisation. Gravity, continuous friction, and energy loss on wall and flipper contacts all act on the ball, so its speed evolves dynamically throughout play. Two paddle-like flippers at the base are driven by the strike policy (See details in Section 2.3 ) to keep the ball in play. The interactive simulator supports two flipper regimes of increasing physical realism. In the binary-gate regime, a flipper acts only at the instant it is triggered, and has no effect on the ball otherwise, isolating the perception-action chain from post-contact physics. In the solid flipper regime, the flippers are persistent colliders that occupy the playfield at all times and deflect the ball on contact, whether or not actively triggered, thereby reproducing the contact dynamics a human player intuits. These two regimes define the two closed-loop experiments of Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 交互式游戏模拟器(图2 C)将最小版本扩展为完整的可播放环境,恢复了字符化过程中省略的视觉和机械复杂性. 重力,持续的摩擦,以及壁上和翻转器接触器上的能量损失都发生在球上,因此其速度在整个游戏中都会动态地演化. 基地的两台类似桨状的翻转机受罢工政策(详见第2.3节)的驱动,以保持球的正常运转. 交互式模拟器支持两个不断增强物理现实性的翻转机制. 在二进制中,一个翻转器只在被触发的瞬间发生作用,对球没有其他效果,将感知-动作链与接触后物理分离. 在固态的翻转器制度下,翻转器是长期占据游戏场,并在接触时使球偏转,无论是否积极触发,从而将接触动力再现为人类玩家的内衣. 这两种制度界定了第4节的两个闭路实验。

blocks.en: 2.1.2 Dynamic event-based input accumulation
blocks.zh: 2.1.2 动态事件输入积累

blocks.en: The stream of events is acquired using a Prophesee EVK4-HD event-based camera [ 54 ] ( 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 px), positioned ∼ \sim 75 cm in front of an HP P24q G4 HD monitor displaying the pinball environment. Rather than the full playfield, the camera is configured to record only a 128 × 128 128\times 128 px region of interest (ROI) around the flippers and drain, marked by the white square in Figure 1 (introduced in Section 2 ). This choice reflects the structure of the task; the decisive moment occurs as the ball approaches the lower region, so tracking the ball across the entire playfield is unnecessary. The ROI nonetheless spans a substantial part of the playfield, providing sufficient context for tracking while reducing the input size, and with it the number of required input neurons and synaptic connections, resulting in a smaller, more energy-efficient spiking network suited for resource-constrained neuromorphic hardware.
blocks.zh: 事件流是使用一个预言EVK4-HD基于事件相机[54](1280×720 1280\times 720 px)获得的,将\sim 75 cm定位在HP P24q G4 HD显示弹球环境的显示器前. 相机的配置不是全播放场,而是只记录一个128×128128\times128 px感兴趣的区域(ROI)围绕翻盘和排水沟,图1中的白色方块(引入于第2节)来标注. 这种选择反映了任务的结构;决定性的时刻在球接近下区时出现,因此在整个球场上跟踪球是不必要的. 尽管如此,ROI还是横跨了游戏场的相当大一部分,为跟踪提供了足够的背景,同时减少了输入大小,随着它,所需的输入神经元和突触连接的数量也随之增加,从而形成了一个更小,更节能的溢出网络,适合资源紧张的神经形态硬件.

blocks.en:
Each event ( x , y ) (x,y) within the ROI drives the Input Population, which generates the spiking activity of the sP network, and is streamed to the SpiNNaker board over Ethernet as a real-time, low-latency input. These events are accumulated into packages for the model, either over a constant time interval ( Δ ​ T \Delta T ) or over a fixed number of events.
A constant time interval (CTI) accumulation window ( Δ ​ T \Delta T ) is initially adopted to forward events to the model. At higher ball speeds, however, this approach introduces temporal overlap: within the same Δ ​ T \Delta T interval, events may correspond to multiple spatial locations of the ball, yielding a blurred trajectory rather than a discrete snapshot.
As shown in Figure 3 , at 1000 px/s and 60 Hz refresh rate, a pseudo-frame shows multiple event clusters corresponding to different ball positions, representing its trajectory rather than an instantaneous state (without the refresh-rate constraint, the motion would appear continuous, forming a single uninterrupted streak instead of discrete clusters).
Since TDE cells rely on precise temporal ordering across adjacent receptive fields, this behaviour degrades the spiking motion estimation network, where multiple ball positions within a single pseudo-frame disrupt the facilitation-trigger sequence. This effect is most pronounced when the receptive field is smaller than the displacement over one Δ ​ T \Delta T , allowing the ball to cross several segments between updates. Reducing Δ ​ T \Delta T only partially mitigates this issue; while shorter windows reduce motion overlap, they can produce sparse input for slow motion and may fail to capture sufficient information. Moreover, smaller Δ ​ T \Delta T increases the transfer rate to the SpiNNaker board, raising communication overhead and risking Ethernet congestion.
blocks.zh:
ROI内部的每个事件(x,y) (x,y)都会驱动输入人口(Involution Publication),这产生SP网络的溢出活动,并作为实时,低纬度输入在以太网上空流到Spinnaker板上. 这些事件被累积成模型的软件包,或者在一个恒定的时间间隔(QQ T\Delta T)中,或者在一个固定的事件数中.
最初采用恒定时间间隔(CTI)积累窗口(QQ T\Delta T),将事件转发给模型. 然而,在更高的球速上,这种方法引入了时间重叠:在同一QQ T\Delta T间隔内,事件可能与球的多个空间位置相对应,产生一个模糊的轨迹而不是一个离散的快照.
如图3所示,在1000px/s和60Hz刷新率下,假帧显示与不同的球位相对应的多个事件集群,代表其轨迹而不是瞬时状态(没有刷新率的制约,运动会显得连续,形成单个不间断的串流而不是离散的集群).
由于TDE细胞依赖于精确的时间顺序,跨越相邻的可接受字段,因此这种行为会降解飞跃运动估计网络,其中单个伪框内的多个球位会扰乱便利-触发序列. 当接受球场小于一个QQ T\Delta T的移位时,这种效果最为明显,允许球在更新之间跨多个段. 减少 & T\Delta T只部分缓解了这个问题;虽然较短的窗口减少了运动重叠,但是它们能产生稀少的输入,用于慢运动,可能无法捕捉到足够的信息. 而且,较小的T\Delta T提高了Spinnaker板的转会率,提高了通信的间接费用,并冒以太网拥堵的风险.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Effect of temporal accumulation for a fixed accumulation window on pseudo-frames at increasing ball speeds. Pseudo-frames are formed by accumulating positive events over Δ ​ T = 20 \Delta T=20 ms. Green dots indicate positive events. At low speeds, events form a compact representation of the ball, while at higher speeds, the pseudo-frame exhibits elongated or multiple clusters, illustrating motion-induced temporal overlap and smearing.

blocks.en: An alternative collection of events relies on event counting, which generates a package of events after a fixed number of events ( N e ​ v ​ t N_{evt} ). This approach adapts to motion speed; however, in real-time use, slow motion can increase latency due to the time required to accumulate enough events. In this work, an adaptive event-count package method (AECP) is proposed; event packages are collected by combining event-count and time-bounded accumulation, using either N e ​ v ​ t N_{evt} or a maximum time limit Δ ​ T m ​ a ​ x \Delta T_{max} . In the proposed Adaptive event-count packaging (AECP) method, events are accumulated using two complementary constraints: a fixed number of events, N evt N_{\mathrm{evt}} , and a maximum accumulation time, Δ ​ T max \Delta T_{\mathrm{max}} . Event accumulation stops as soon as either constraint is satisfied, with the first condition reached determining the end of the current package of events. During periods of rapid motion, the event generation rate increases significantly, allowing the threshold N evt N_{\mathrm{evt}} to be reached before Δ ​ T max \Delta T_{\mathrm{max}} . Consequently, the accumulation window is adaptively shortened, resulting in lower latency while preserving sufficient spatial information. Conversely, during periods of low activity, when events are generated more sparsely, Δ ​ T max \Delta T_{\mathrm{max}} guarantees that a package of events is produced within a bounded time, preventing excessive delays in downstream processing. This hybrid accumulation strategy provides an effective trade-off between low latency and temporally consistent neuromorphic input by adaptively switching between event-driven and time-driven framing according to the scene dynamics (see Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 另一种事件集依赖于事件计数,它生成一个在固定事件数后的事件包(Ne v t N_{evt}). 这种方法适应运动速度;然而,在实时使用中,由于需要时间来积累足够的事件,慢动作可以增加耐久性. 在这项工作中,提出了适应性事件计数包法(AECP);通过合并事件计数和有时间限制的积累来收集事件包,使用N e v t N_{vt}或者一个最长的限值QQ T m a x\Delta T_{max}. 在拟议的适应性事件计数包装(AECP)方法中,事件是利用两个互补的制约因素来积累的:一个固定的事件数量,N evt N _{\mathrm{evt}},以及一个最大积累时间,Q T Max\Delta T_{\mathrm{max}}. 一旦满足了这两种限制,事件累积就会停止,第一个条件就是决定当前一揽子事件的结束。 在快速运动期间,事件生成率大幅提升,使得在QQ T Max\Delta T_{\mathrm{max}前达到阈值N evt N_{\mathrm{evt}. 因此,积累窗口因地制宜地缩短,从而降低延迟度,同时保留足够的空间信息。 反之,在活动程度低、活动次数少的时期, QQ T max t_{\mathrm{max} 保证在一定时间内生产一套活动, 防止下游加工过度延误。 这种混合堆积策略通过根据场景动态在事件驱动和时间驱动的框架之间进行适应性转换,在低延迟和时间一致性神经形态输入之间提供了有效的权衡(见图4).

blocks.en: Figure 4: Comparison between Constant Time Interval (CTI) accumulation and the Adaptive Event-Count Framing (AECP) method at different ball velocities (100, 200, 400, and 1000 px/s). Each pseudo-frame displays 200 positive events (not showing the negative events) accumulated within either a fixed temporal window ( Δ ​ T = 20 \Delta T=20 ms, top row) or an adaptive window determined by the AECP strategy (bottom row). In the CTI case, higher speeds cause elongated or duplicated event clusters due to temporal overlap, resulting in motion-induced blur. In contrast, the adaptive approach automatically shortens Δ ​ T \Delta T at higher velocities, preserving compact and coherent event representations while maintaining temporal consistency across motion conditions.

blocks.en: 2.2 Spiking-based pinball (sP) network
blocks.zh: 2.2 Spiking弹球网

blocks.en: The spiking-based pinball (sP) network (Figure 1 ) transforms the raw event stream ( 2.1.1 ) into a fully spiking, real-time estimate of the ball’s state, comprising its position ( x , y ) (x,y) , speed v v , and direction of motion ϕ \phi . The sP network consists of four successive population layers: Input & Denoising, Filter & Segmentation, Direction-Selective, and Readout populations. Each stage is detailed in the following subsections.
blocks.zh: 基于spilling的弹球(sP)网络(图1)将原始事件流(2.1.1)转换为完全spilling的,实时的球体状态估计,包括其位置(x,y) (x,y),速度v v,以及运动的方向_\\\phi. sP网络由连续四个人口层组成:输入层和Denoising层,过滤层和分层层,方向-选择层和Readout群. 以下各小节详细介绍了每个阶段。

blocks.en: The SNN sP model is implemented and developed using the PyNN framework [ 17 ] , and deployed on a SpiNNaker-5 neuromorphic computing platform [ 28 ] . The SpiNNaker-5 board is a massively parallel low-power architecture designed specifically for large-scale spiking neural network simulation in real time. Each board contains multiple ARM-based processing cores interconnected through an asynchronous packet-based communication fabric that natively supports spike routing with high reliability and extremely low latency. This architecture enables efficient emulation of biologically inspired neural dynamics and large-scale connectivity patterns while maintaining deterministic timing. These properties are essential for real-time neuromorphic robotics and closed-loop interaction with sensory input streams such as DVS event data.
blocks.zh: SNN sP模型使用PyNN框架实施和开发[17],并部署在Spinnaker-5神经形态计算平台[28]. Spinnaker-5板是一个大规模平行的低功率建筑,专门设计用于实时大规模喷发神经网络模拟. 每个板都包含多个基于ARM的处理核心,通过一个基于同步包的通信架构互相连接,这些架构在本土上支持具有高度可靠性和极低延迟的悬索路由. 这种结构能够有效地模拟生物激发的神经动态和大规模连接模式,同时保持决定性的时间。 这些属性对于实时神经形态机器人和与感官输入流(如DVS事件数据)的闭路互动至关重要.

blocks.en: At the input stage, positive events are accumulated using the hybrid adaptive event-count package (AECP) approach, with a Δ ​ T \Delta T empirically determined during characterisation and a fixed cap of N evt = 500 N_{\mathrm{evt}}=500 events per package. This upper bound reflects the ball’s size (radius = 15 px), which occupies approximately 1 % 1\% of the selected region of interest ( 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels) of the pinball playfield (see Section 3 for parameter selection details). Restricting accumulation to positive (leading-edge) events halves the input event rate, further reducing the computational load of downstream processing without discarding motion-relevant information, since the trailing edge of the ball’s silhouette carries largely redundant timing cues. Each event package is first passed through a Gaussian kernel for denoising and smoothing (Section 2.2.1 ), and the smoothed output is then forwarded to the segmentation population, which splits the input space into a grid of non-overlapping receptive fields (RFs), each spanning an N × N N\times N block of neurons. Within each RF, all neurons converge onto a single neuron in the resulting segmentation map, so that the original input is represented at a coarser spatial resolution downstream. The RF size (N) is a configurable parameter whose impact on system performance is investigated in Section 2.2.2 . Pooling within receptive fields both reduces the computational cost of the downstream network and improves robustness to the discontinuous motion artefacts introduced by the simulator’s 60 Hz display.
blocks.zh: 在输入阶段,正态事件是使用混合适应事件计数包(AECP)方法积累的,在特征化过程中按经验确定为QQ T\Delta T,每包固定上限为N evt = 500 N_{\mathrm{evt}}=500事件. 此上方绑定反映了球的大小( radius = 15 px) , 该球占据了弹球游戏场中选定感兴趣的区域( 256 × 256\times 256 像素) 的大约1% = 1% (参数选择细节见第 3 节). 将累积限制在正(前缘)事件上,输入事件率减半,从而进一步减少下游处理的计算负荷,而不丢弃与运动有关的信息,因为球的后缘部分带有大量冗余的时间提示。 每个事件包首先通过一个高斯内核来解析和平滑(第2.2.1节),平滑的输出然后传递给分块群,分块群将输入空间分割成一个不重叠的可接受域(RF)的网格,每个网格跨越一个N×N\Times N块神经元. 在每个RF内部,所有的神经元在产生的分化图中会汇合到一个单一的神经元上,这样原始的输入就表现在下游的较宽空间分辨率上. RF大小(N)是一个可配置参数,它对系统性能的影响在第2.2.2节中调查. 在可接受字段内集中,既降低了下游网络的计算成本,也提高了模拟器60赫兹显示器引入的不连续运动工艺的稳健性。

blocks.en: The segmentation map provides input to eight Direction-Selective (DS) populations via structured synaptic connectivity between neighbouring RF cells (see Section 2.2.3 ). Each DS population is implemented as a TDE population and is tuned to one of the eight principal directions available within a 2 × 2 2\times 2 RF neighbourhood, yielding an angular resolution of 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} . While this resolution is sufficient for coarse motion detection, it is inadequate for accurately estimating the trajectory and velocity vector of the ball. The identity of the winning DS population gives a coarse motion direction, and its mean firing rate gives ball speed. To sharpen this estimate, an additional readout layer comprising 36 neurons was introduced. All eight DS outputs project onto this angle-readout population (Section 2.2.4 , Equation 3 ), in which each neuron represents a 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} interval. This yields a continuous, fine-grained estimate of motion direction and, consequently, a more accurate velocity vector.

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Segmentation population
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 分区人口

blocks.en: The pinball simulation is displayed on an HP P24q G4 monitor operating at a refresh rate of 60 Hz (Section 2.1.2 ), introducing temporal discretisation into the visual stimulus. Although the simulator provides the ground-truth position and velocity of the ball at every simulation step, the displayed motion is constrained by the monitor’s refresh interval (16.67 ms). Consequently, the apparent motion observed by the event camera differs from the continuous ground-truth trajectory. At low ball speeds (e.g., 60 px/s), the displacement between consecutive frames is approximately 1 pixel, resulting in smooth, continuous motion. However, at higher speeds (e.g., 600 px/s), the ball can travel up to 10 pixels between successive screen refreshes, producing discontinuous spatial jumps. Event accumulation cannot reconstruct these missing intermediate positions, since no visual information is presented during the skipped intervals. Such discontinuities are particularly detrimental for spiking motion-detection systems, which estimate motion by exploiting the precise temporal relationships of spikes generated across neighbouring receptive fields. As a result, the temporal sampling imposed by the display becomes a limiting factor for reliable motion estimation at high ball velocities, despite the simulator providing accurate continuous ground-truth dynamics. The available 60 Hz monitor was used nonetheless, as it let the DVS observe a realistic scene under the same conditions as the interactive game and physical demonstrator, rather than bypassing the camera via synthetic events.
blocks.zh: 弹球模拟显示在HP P24q G4显示器上,运行速度为60赫兹(第2.1.2节),将时间盘化引入视觉刺激。 虽然模拟器提供了每个模拟步骤的球的地面真实位置和速度,但显示的运动受到显示器刷新间隔(16.67毫秒)的限制. 因此,事件摄像头观察到的明显运动与连续的地面真实轨迹不同。 在低球速(如60px/s)时,连续帧之间的移位约为1像素,从而产生平滑,连续的运动. 然而,在更高的速度(如600px/s)下,球可以在连续屏幕刷新之间穿梭高达10像素,产生不连续的空间跳跃. 事件累积不能重建这些缺失的中间位置,因为在跳过间隔期间没有显示任何视觉信息。 这种不连续尤其不利于闪烁的运动探测系统,该系统通过利用在邻近可接受领域产生的突起的确切时间关系来估计运动。 因此,尽管模拟器提供了准确的连续地面真实动态,但显示所施加的时间抽样成为在高球速度下可靠运动估计的限制因素。 尽管如此,还是使用了可用的60Hz显示器,因为它让DVS在与交互式游戏和物理演示器相同的条件下观察一个现实的场景,而不是通过合成事件绕过镜头.

blocks.en: In the proposed pipeline, the TDE [ 39 ] encodes the temporal difference between stimuli received by neighbouring RFs (i.e. the sEMD [ 47 , 14 , 46 ] ). Each RF’s synapse is connected to a single TDE, making RF size the key factor determining the measurable velocity range. Selecting an appropriate RF size is therefore essential for covering the desired range of ball speeds. To characterise the model, the system exploits the dependence of receptive field size on preferred ball speed. Smaller RFs are more sensitive to slow motion, as they require only a small displacement to trigger successive activations across neighbouring units, whereas larger RFs are more robust to the large displacements produced by fast motion. To characterise the model (Section 3 ) and determine suitable RF dimensions for the full range of expected ball velocities, controlled experiments are conducted using a minimal simulation setup. The appropriate RF size is identified by grouping neighbouring cells during the segmentation process, selecting the configuration that balances spatial precision with robustness to high-speed motion. Although a fully biologically inspired solution would rely on multiple parallel pipelines operating at different spatial scales, this is not feasible under the strict hardware and power constraints of embedded neuromorphic systems. Instead, a compact, resource-efficient design is adopted, evaluating several receptive field grouping sizes and analysing their impact on performance.
blocks.zh: 在拟议的管道中,TDE[39]编码了邻近区域论坛(即SEMD[47、14、46])收到的刺激之间的时间差。 每个RF的突触都与单一的TDE相连,使RF大小成为决定可测量速度范围的关键因素. 因此,选择适当的RF尺寸对涵盖所期望的球速范围至关重要。 为了给模型定性,系统利用了接受球场大小对首选球速的依赖. 小一点 报告书对慢运动更为敏感,因为只需小幅迁移即可引发相邻单位的连续激活,而较大的报告书对快速运动产生的大面积迁移则更为有力。 为了确定模型的特性(第3节),并确定所有预期球速的适当RF维度,利用最低限度的模拟设置进行受控实验。 适当的RF大小是通过在分化过程中分组相邻的细胞来识别的,选择在空间精度与稳健性与高速运动之间保持平衡的配置. 虽然一个完全由生物启发的解决方案将依赖于多个平行的管道在不同空间尺度上运行,但是在嵌入式神经形态系统的严格硬件和动力限制下,这是不可能的. 相反,采用了紧凑、资源效率高的设计,评价若干可接受的外地分组规模,并分析其对业绩的影响。

blocks.en: 2.2.3 Direction-selective (DS) populations
blocks.zh: 2.2.3 定向选择性人口

blocks.en:
The implementation of the direction-selective (DS) populations is inspired by motion-processing mechanisms observed in areas V1 and MT/V5 of the primate visual cortex [ 61 , 59 ] . This design builds upon foundational studies of biological motion perception, including the Hassenstein–Reichardt detector [ 40 ] and later extensions by Borst and Egelhaaf [ 8 ] , which established the principles of correlation-based Elementary Motion Detectors (EMDs).
In the proposed architecture, DS populations are implemented using spiking Elementary Motion Detectors (sEMDs) available within the SpiNNaker framework [ 47 , 14 , 46 ] . Each sEMD incorporates a Time-Difference Encoder (TDE) [ 39 ] , enabling the estimation of motion through the temporal relationship between neighbouring receptive field activations.
A TDE unit receives inputs from two adjacent RFs and encodes their relative activation timing, which is inversely related to the velocity of the moving stimulus. Following the architecture proposed in [ 39 ] , one input is routed through a facilitation synapse and the other through a trigger synapse. The facilitation synapse generates an exponentially decaying gain signal, while the trigger synapse produces an excitatory postsynaptic current whose amplitude is modulated by this gain. When a stimulus moves in the preferred direction, the facilitation input precedes the trigger input, increasing the postsynaptic response sufficiently to drive the membrane potential above threshold and elicit one or more spikes (Figure 6 ). Within each 2 × 2 2\times 2 neighbourhood, eight DS populations are defined to cover all possible motion pathways: two directions for each of the four orientations (horizontal, vertical, and the two diagonals). The facilitator–trigger ordering of the synaptic connections determines the preferred direction of each population (Figure 6 ). The eight DS populations operate in parallel and feed a winner-take-all (WTA) population. Through lateral inhibition, the WTA suppresses less active populations, allowing the most active DS population to indicate the dominant direction of motion (see Readout Populations in Figure 1 ). As the TDE mechanism encodes traversal time through spike timing, the mean firing rate (MFR) of the winning population is expected to correlate with the object’s velocity; this relationship is characterised in Section 3 .

在灵长类视觉皮层V1和MT/V5区观测到的运动处理机制[61,59]激励了定向选择性(DS)群的落实. 这一设计基于对生物运动感知的基础研究,包括Hassenstein–Reichardt探测器[40],以及后来由Borst和Egelhaaf[8]的扩展,后者确立了基于相关性的初级运动探测器(EMDs)的原则.
在拟议的结构中,DS群是使用Spinnaker框架内的尖端初级运动探测器[47、14、46]实施的。 每个SEMD都包含一个时差编码器(TDE)[39],通过相邻的可接受字段激活之间的时间关系来估计运动.
一个TDE单元接收两个相邻的RF输入,并编码了它们的相对激活时间,这与移动刺激的速度有反向关系. 按照[39]中提议的架构,一个输入通过便利突触进行路由,另一个通过触发突触进行路由. 促动突触产生指数衰变增益信号,而触发突触则产生振动后突触电流,振幅由这一增益调节. 当刺激向首选方向移动时,便利化输入先于触发输入,将突触后的反应充分增加,使膜潜力超过阈值,并引起一个或多个峰值(图6)。 在每2×2 2\times 2个街区内,8个DS人口被定义覆盖所有可能的运动路径:四个方向(横向,垂直,和两个对角)各有两个方向. 助推器 - 触发突触连接的顺序决定每个人群的优先方向(图6). 社会保障部的8个人口同时运作,养活一个全胜者。 通过横向抑制,WTA抑制了活动较少的人群,使得最活跃的DS人群能够指示运动的主要方向(见图1中的Readout Populations . 由于TDE机制将穿越时间编码为突起时间,因此获胜人群的平均发射率预计将与物体的速度相关;这种关系在第3节中作了说明。

blocks.en: The proposed model addresses the problem of estimating continuous motion direction directly on neuromorphic hardware from the eight DS populations introduced in the previous subsection. In several event-based vision systems, this decoding step is instead performed off-board using conventional processors [ 29 ] . In this work, the goal is to perform the decoding fully on-board by introducing a dedicated Angle Readout (AR) population. To this end, the angle readout layer is composed of 36 neurons, each representing a preferred direction ϕ j \phi_{j} with an angular resolution of 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} . Each neuron in this population receives synaptic input from all neurons in the eight DS populations. A normalised Gaussian tuning function defines the connection strengths centred on the neuron’s preferred angle. Specifically, the synaptic weight w i ​ j w_{ij} from DS population i i to readout neuron j j in the AR population is defined by Equation 3 . This value is evenly divided among all individual synaptic connections from the i i -th DS population to neuron j j , such that their sum equals w i ​ j w_{ij} .

2.3 sP output and strike policy
blocks.zh: 2.3 sP产出和罢工政策

blocks.en:
The final stage of the pipeline integrates the extracted motion information to generate an actionable flipper-control decision. The outputs of the eight DS populations and the angle readout layer provide a spiking representation of the ball’s motion direction ( ϕ \phi ) and an estimate of its speed ( v v ).
In parallel, the output of the filter-map (Section 2.2.1 ) provides a coarse but reliable estimate of the ball’s instantaneous location within the field of view ( x , y ) (x,y) . The spatial structure of this filtered representation enables identification of the currently active region of the scene, allowing the system to track the ball’s position relative to the left and right flippers. In this formulation, by using the estimated state vector ( x , y , v , ϕ ) (x,y,v,\phi) , the decision-making strike policy module (running on the host CPU alongside the simulator) predicts the next position of the ball and selects the flipper to actuate (Figure 1 ).

blocks.en: The strike policy is a deliberately minimal and transparent design; it triggers the corresponding flipper whenever the predicted ball position enters that flipper’s strike region, with no learning or tuning of timing beyond this geometric condition. This choice is intentional, as the aim of this work is to evaluate the neuromorphic perception pipeline rather than to engineer an optimal controller. Coupling the spiking state estimate to the simplest possible decision rule ensures that closed-loop performance reflects the quality of perception rather than policy sophistication. The geometry of the strike region depends on the flipper physics and is specified per regime in Section 4 , where the policy is evaluated under two flipper regimes against human players.

blocks.en: 3 sP system characterisation
blocks.zh: 3 sP 系统字符化

blocks.en:
System characterisation is performed by systematically varying three key parameters, receptive field (RF) size, spike accumulation window ( Δ ​ T \Delta T ), and angular tuning width ( σ \sigma ), across a controlled range of ball velocities.
The accurate estimation of the velocity vector ( x , y , v , ϕ ) (x,y,v,\phi) requires reliable measurements of both speed ( v v ) and direction ( ϕ \phi ). Motion estimation in the DS populations is inferred from the mean firing rate (MFR) of the recorded neural activity of the TDE cells. Consequently, the effects of RF size and Δ ​ T \Delta T on direction selectivity and speed estimation are first evaluated to identify the most effective DS population configuration. Angular estimation is then assessed from the angle readout (AR) population, which combines the outputs of the eight DS populations through a weighted tuning mechanism. Because the AR population depends on accurate directional responses from the DS layer, the parameter σ \sigma is optimised only after selecting the best RF size and Δ ​ T \Delta T configuration for the DS populations. Overall, the characterisation process first identifies the RF size and Δ ​ T \Delta T that maximise direction detection and speed estimation performance, and subsequently determines the optimal σ \sigma value for angular estimation.

准确估计速度矢量(x, y, v, φ) (x, y, v,\phi)需要可靠地测量速度(v)和方向(\\\phi). 从TDE细胞记录神经活性的平均燃烧率(MFR)推断出DS人群的运动估计. 因此,首先评价RF规模和QQ T\Delta T对方向选择和速度估计的影响,以确定最有效的DS人口配置。 然后从角读出(AR)群评估角估计,通过加权调制机制将8个DS群的输出结合起来. 由于AR群依赖于来自DS层的准确方向反应,参数 \\sigma只有在为DS群选择了最佳RF大小和QQ T\Delta T配置后才得到优化. 总体来说,性格化过程首先确定RF大小和QQ T\Delta T,使方向检测和速度估计性能最大化,然后确定角估计的最佳\\\ sigma值.

blocks.en: 3.1 Direction selectivity and speed estimation
blocks.zh: 3.1 方向选择性和速度估计

blocks.en: To identify an optimal configuration of Δ ​ T \Delta T and RF size for the DS populations, the minimal Pinball Game Simulator introduced in Section 2.1.1 is used (see Figure 2 ). Eight experiments are defined, each corresponding to a discrete motion direction ( 0 ∘ , 45 ∘ , … , 315 ∘ 0^{\circ},45^{\circ},\dots,315^{\circ} ), with ball speeds uniformly changed in the range 0–1000 px/s, increasing and decreasing in increments of 100 px/s. Each speed is maintained for a 1-second interval, and the entire sequence is repeated three times (See Figure 2 b). This controlled setup enables a precise comparison between the simulated ground-truth trajectories and the motion estimated by the spiking-based Pinball network, also facilitating parameter tuning and validation of the event-based sensing and preprocessing stages.
blocks.zh: 为了为DS人群确定QQ T\Delta T和RF尺寸的最佳配置,采用了第2.1.1节引入的最低平球游戏模拟器(见图2). 8个实验被定义,每个实验对应一个离散运动方向(0 ,45∘,.,315∘,0^{\,45^{\,dots,315^{\,circ}),球速在0–1000px/s之间统一变化,增减100px/s. 每个速度维持1秒间隔,整个序列重复三次(见图2b). 这种有控制的设置能够精确地比较模拟地面真实轨迹和以跳跃为基础的平球网络所估计的运动,也便于参数调整和验证以事件为基础的感测和预处理阶段。

blocks.en: For each experiment, the RF size in the segmentation map is varied across five configurations ( 3 × 3 3\times 3 , 5 × 5 5\times 5 , 7 × 7 7\times 7 , 9 × 9 9\times 9 , and 11 × 11 11\times 11 pixels). Larger RFs increase robustness to fast motion but reduce spatial precision, while smaller RFs improve localisation accuracy at the expense of sensitivity to high-speed displacements (see Section 2.2.2 ). For each RF size, Δ ​ T \Delta T is swept over 16.7  ms, 40  ms, and 100  ms with a fixed event-count threshold of N evt = 500 N_{\mathrm{evt}}=500 events, and the resulting accuracy in both direction and speed estimation is evaluated. N evt N_{\mathrm{evt}} is selected based on the geometric characteristics of the task. The ball has a radius of 15 pixels within a 256 × 256 256\times 256 playfield, corresponding to roughly 1% of the total area.

N evt N_{\ mathrm{ evt}根据任务的几何特征选择. 球在256×256256\times 256 playfield内半径为15像素,相当于总面积的约1%.

blocks.en:
After the Gaussian downsampling of the ROI to 64 × 64 64\times 64 , the ball occupies a small, bounded region of fewer than 200 active cells. Considering event noise, specular reflections, and the tendency of a single pixel to generate multiple events over time, a conservative upper bound of 500 events is adopted. This ensures that sufficient motion information is accumulated under most conditions while avoiding excessive integration delays.
Overall, the evaluation consists of 8 × 5 × 3 8\times 5\times 3 configurations, corresponding to eight motion directions, five RF sizes, and three Δ ​ T \Delta T values. For each configuration, direction detection performance is assessed by comparing the outputs of the eight DS neurons in the readout population (each corresponding to one DS population) with the ground-truth motion vectors generated by the simulator. Specifically, spikes from the eight DS neurons are accumulated over each Δ ​ T \Delta T window, and the winning neuron is defined as the one with the highest spike count. Its associated class is taken as the predicted motion direction, and accuracy is computed using Equation 6 .

blocks.en: Speed estimation in the proposed model is derived directly from the temporal dynamics of the TDE cells. As the ball traverses consecutive RFs, the TDE mechanism converts the time difference into characteristic spike bursts. Figure 7 shows the MFR computed over a 100 100 ms window for the eight DS populations. The neuron tuned to upward motion shows clear firing-rate modulation following changes in ball velocity, while the remaining populations remain largely inactive. This confirms the effectiveness of the WTA mechanism in suppressing non-relevant motion hypotheses and isolating a single dominant DS response.

blocks.en:
As a result, the mean firing rate (MFR) of the winning DS neuron exhibits a monotonic relationship with object velocity, enabling speed estimation through temporal coding without explicit spatial tracking.
To quantify this relationship, both the MFR and the ground-truth speed are normalised prior to regression to remove scale differences and allow fair comparison across RF sizes and spike accumulation windows. Error metrics are therefore expressed in normalised units and capture estimation accuracy rather than absolute physical calibration (See Table 2 ).

为了量化这种关系,MFR和地面-真实速度在回归之前都实现了正常化,以消除尺度差异,并允许在RF大小和悬崖堆积窗口之间进行公平比较。 因此,误差的衡量标准以正常单位表示,并捕获估计准确性,而不是绝对物理校准(见表2)。

Performance is evaluated using complementary metrics. The Pearson correlation coefficient ( r r ) measures linear dependence between estimated and true speeds, while the coefficient of determination ( R 2 R^{2} ) quantifies the proportion of explained variance. Mean Absolute Error (MAE) reflects average estimation error, and RMSE emphasises larger deviations and outliers.
Additionally, Figure 8 reports the standard deviation of the normalised firing rate as a function of speed for different RF sizes.

blocks.en:
Table 1 and 2 show that both RF size and accumulation window Δ ​ T \Delta T significantly affect performance. Increasing Δ ​ T \Delta T improves all metrics by stabilising firing-rate estimates through longer temporal integration. The Δ ​ T = 100 \Delta T=100 ms condition yields the highest accuracy in Table 1 , as well as the best correlation and lowest error across RF sizes, representing an upper bound on estimation performance.
However, this latency is not compatible with real-time pinball interaction. As discussed in Section 2.1.2 , larger Δ ​ T \Delta T also leads to greater inter-frame displacement of the ball, which degrades spatial consistency and positional accuracy. In contrast, shorter windows ( 16.7 16.7 – 40 40 ms) preserve temporal responsiveness while maintaining acceptable accuracy, particularly for smaller RFs ( 3 × 3 3\times 3 and 5 × 5 5\times 5 ), which provide the best trade-off between precision and robustness. Moreover, smaller RFs exhibit lower and more stable variability across most speeds, whereas larger RFs show increased variance (Figure 8 ), especially at higher velocities. This behaviour is consistent with the degradation in estimation accuracy observed for larger RF configurations.
Overall, to ensure real-time operation and low-latency decision-making, the RF sizes of 3 × 3 3\times 3 and 5 × 5 5\times 5 combined with Δ ​ T = 16.7 \Delta T=16.7 ms are selected as the preferred operating configuration to investigate the angular specificity of the model in the following section.

blocks.en:
Based on the characterisation results, a final network configuration was selected to provide accurate speed estimation and direction perception while satisfying the real-time constraints of the pinball task.
The speed and direction detection capabilities of the model were evaluated across different RF sizes and accumulation windows. As shown in Section 3.1 , increasing Δ ​ T \Delta T improves performance by stabilising neural firing rates. However, because real-time ball localisation and rapid flipper actuation are essential, the Δ ​ T = 16.7 \Delta T=16.7 ms is selected despite its slightly lower estimation accuracy. Using this accumulation window, the RF size analysis identified 3 × 3 3\times 3 and 5 × 5 5\times 5 as the most effective configurations for the DS populations. The subsequent angular specificity analysis showed that only the 3 × 3 3\times 3 RF provides sufficient angular resolution while maintaining limited overlap between neighbouring angle estimates. Furthermore, among the tested tuning widths, σ = 30 \sigma=30 produced the best balance between smooth angular representation and angular specificity. Consequently, the final configuration adopted for the SpiNNaker implementation uses an RF size of 3 × 3 3\times 3 , an accumulation window of Δ ​ T = 16.7 \Delta T=16.7 ms, and an angular tuning width of σ = 30 \sigma=30 . Parameters for the sP network are shown in Table 3 . Overall, these results demonstrate that compact RFs combined with short accumulation windows enable reliable motion estimation with low latency, making the proposed architecture well suited for real-time neuromorphic pinball tracking and control.

Based on these predictions, the strike policy (Section 2.3 ) sends a control command to the game simulator to activate the appropriate flipper, triggering it whenever the ball is predicted to enter that flipper’s strike region. The geometry of this region is specified separately for each experiment. Together, the neuromorphic perception pipeline, the strike policy, and the flipper control signal constitute a single closed-loop agent, which we refer to as the neuromorphic-perception-to-action (nPA) loop throughout this section. The closed loop is evaluated in simulation in two regimes: a binary-gate flipper regime (Section 4.1 ) and a solid flipper regime with more realistic dynamics (Section 4.2 ).
Finally, the operation of the loop is demonstrated on a physical pinball system (see Section 5 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Binary gate flipper regime
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 二进制闸机翻转系统

blocks.en:
In the binary flipper regime, the flippers act as momentary action-gated colliders. A flipper exists as a collidable surface only during the frame in which it is actively triggered: a correctly timed trigger deflects the ball back into play, while a mistimed one leaves no collider present, and the ball passes through the flipper area along its original trajectory. Since the flipper has no physical presence unless correctly triggered, the interaction reduces to a single all-or-nothing timing decision.
The strike region is a disc of one ball-radius around the flipper: the reactive policy triggers when the predicted ball position falls within this region, while a hit is scored when the actual ball position satisfies the same condition. Pairing the binary gate with a triggering rule matched to the hit-success criterion isolates the perception-and-prediction chain as far as possible, excluding post-trigger physics, so a miss reflects perception and prediction accuracy rather than the trigger threshold.

击球区是一盘环绕翻球的球体:当预测的球位置落在这个区域内时,反应性政策触发,而当实际球位置满足同样条件时,击球即得分. 用与命中成功标准相匹配的触发规则对准二进制门,尽可能隔离感知和预测链,排除后触发物理学,因此误差反映感知和预测准确性而不是触发阈值.

blocks.en: To provide a baseline for evaluating the efficiency of the loop and to assess how its real-time performance compares to human reaction capabilities, the nPA is compared against human players on the identical task. This evaluation conducts a user study in which 10 participants played the pinball game using manual keyboard control of the flippers 3 3 3 https://github.com/MazdakFatahi/PinBallSimulator . Each participant played 100 balls, with the maximum ball speed limited to 1000 px/s. The game is a physics-based simulator in which parameters such as gravity, continuous friction, wall and flipper reflection coefficients, and energy loss during wall bounces dynamically affect the ball’s speed throughout the simulation. As a result accurate action time is not easy to predict, and both the number of flipper activations and the number of successful hits vary across players (Table 4 ). The nPA loop was evaluated over 10 independent runs using the same visual setup and ball count, the average over these runs is reported in the last column of Table 4 .

blocks.en:
Figure 10 reports hits and actions per episode for each participant and for the nPA loop. Results of human players are scattered across both axes, tracing the task’s accuracy–economy trade-off. Participants adopted strategies from precise (player 2 and 6 achieving high hit rates from few actions) to aggressive (players 4 and 7, acting several times as often for comparable return). The nPA loop occupies the favourable upper-left corner, matching the top of the human hit range while spending far fewer actions than any human of comparable output. Equivalently, its 56.1% hit rate is comparable to the most accurate individuals and more than double the human average of 25.6% (Table 4 ).
This economy is diagnostic of perception quality: a high hit count at low action counts implies estimated position and velocity accurate enough for reliable strike timing under real-time constraints, whereas noisier perception would require many activations for the same return, shifting an agent rightward, as seen for the more aggressive players. Achieving this at a fixed rate of one command per Δ ​ T = 16.7 \Delta T=16.7 ms indicates that fully spike-based event-driven perception can operate within the latency budget required for closed-loop sensorimotor control; the corresponding latency and energy numbers are reported in Section 5.1 .

这种经济是对感知质量的诊断:低动作计数的高命中数意味着在实时限制下,估计位置和速度的准确性足以用于可靠的打击时间,而鼻音感知则需要许多激活器才能同样回报,将一个剂向右转移,这一点对攻击性较强的玩家来说就是如此。 以每QQ T = 16.7 \Delta T = 16.7 ms 的固定费率实现这一点表明,完全基于突起的事件驱动感知可在闭路感应器控制所需的潜伏预算范围内运作;相应的潜伏度和能量数在第5.1节中报告。

blocks.en:
The binary-gate regime of Section 4.1 isolates the perception–action chain, but at the cost of physical realism, penalising human players, whose intuition of the game is rooted in its physical dynamics. To provide a fairer comparison, the system has been evaluated by introducing a solid flipper regime in which the flippers are persistent colliders, occupying the playfield at all times and deflecting the ball on contact, whether or not they are actively triggered.
In this scenario, the strike region is the triangular area swept by the flipper. As before, the policy triggers when the predicted ball position overlaps it, and a hit is scored when the actual ball position satisfies the same condition. Alongside hit rate and per-episode action economy, the conversion rate is reported, defined as the fraction of confirmed ball–flipper contacts converted into active strikes rather than passive bounces.

blocks.en: As in the binary regime, the nPA loop is compared with human players on the identical task. Twenty participants played the solid flipper game using manual keyboard control, each completing N ep = 30 N_{\mathrm{ep}}=30 balls under the same visual setup and ball-speed limit as in the Binary gate flipper regime (See details in Section 4.1 ). Notably, this coverage holds in the solid flipper regime, where realistic contact physics remove the disadvantage the binary gate imposed on human players. Across the sweep, the nPA loop spans the human player range in both action economy and hit rate, and reaches comparable conversion rates over confirmed ball–flipper contacts.
Since conversion is measured only on balls that reach a flipper, each converted contact requires accurate localisation and arrival prediction to strike in time. The competitive conversion rates across the sweep therefore indicate that the spiking perception–prediction chain remains reliable even under the fairer, physically realistic condition.

To assess whether the same principle operates outside simulation, the physical pinball demonstrator has been additionally built (See Figure 12 ), in which a metal ball moves within a box, and two flippers are driven by servo motors. blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: This work develops a fully neuromorphic motion-estimation (sP) network deployed on the SpiNNaker platform as the perceptual core of a closed-loop pinball agent. The network drives a real-time perception-to-action loop directly from raw DVS events, sustaining the dynamic visuomotor task of pinball gameplay. Across two flipper regimes of the game (Section 4 ), the proposed neuromorphic-perception-to-action (nPA) loop performed within the range spanned by human players while operating under a bounded real-time budget and at sub-milliwatt dynamic power.
blocks.zh: 这项工作发展了部署在Spinnaker平台上的全神经形态运动估计(sP)网络,作为闭环弹球剂的感知核心. 网络直接从原始的DVS事件驱动一个实时的感知对动作循环,维持了弹球游戏游戏的动态visuomotor任务. 跨游戏的两个翻转系统(第4节),拟议神经形态感知-对动作(nPA)环绕在人类玩家的跨度范围内进行,同时在限定的实时预算下运行,以次兆瓦动态功率运行.

blocks.en: The deployed configuration itself reflects a deliberate trade-off investigated during characterisation. The highest direction-detection accuracy and the strongest speed-estimation correlations were both obtained with longer accumulation windows and, for direction, with 5 × 5 5\times 5 receptive fields (Section 3 ); however, these settings degrade angular specificity and are incompatible with the real-time constraints of closed-loop control. The configuration ultimately adopted, 3 × 3 3\times 3 receptive fields with Δ ​ T = 16.7 ​ ms \Delta T=16.7\,\mathrm{ms} , sacrifices some raw accuracy for both angular resolution and latency. Despite operating away from the accuracy-maximising end of the characterisation sweep, the resulting perception remained reliable enough to sustain human-comparable, and at times human-exceeding, performance under real-time constraints, evidence that the reduced accuracy at this operating point did not translate into a meaningful loss of closed-loop capability.
blocks.zh: 部署的配置本身反映了在特征化过程中经过认真调查的权衡。 最高的方向探测精度和最强的速度估计相关性都是用较长的积累窗口获得的,对于方向而言,有5×5 5\times 5可接受字段(第3节);然而,这些设置会降解角特异性,不符合闭路控制时的实时限制. 最终采用的配置,3×3 3\times 3可接受字段,其中QQ T = 16.7 ms\Delta T = 16.7\,\mathrm{ms},为角分辨率和纬度都牺牲了一些原始精度. 尽管操作远离了字符化扫描的精度最大化端,但由此产生的感知仍然足够可靠,足以维持人与人之间的可比性,有时是人与人之间的超越,性能在实时限制下,有证据表明这一操作点的精度降低并没有转化为有意义的闭路能力丧失.

blocks.en:
The pinball setting places a stringent demand on the perception stage. A small, fast ball activates only a sparse subset of receptive fields as it crosses the field of view, in contrast to the stimuli used in most prior EMD/TDE evaluations (wide-field bars, drifting gratings, or large moving objects that activate broad regions of the sensor and therefore probe only coarse directional selectivity [ 34 , 23 , 63 ] ).
Under this sparser activation, the network nevertheless recovers a continuous 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} angular estimate and a velocity vector, rather than a coarse eight-way direction. Sparse activation is the more demanding condition for a local motion detector, and it is also the one relevant to tracking a small target for downstream trajectory estimation, where the informative signal is confined to a few active cells.
blocks.zh:
弹球设定对感知舞台提出了严格的要求. 一个小的快速球在穿越视野时只激活一小部分可接受球场,与大多数之前的EMD/TDE评价中使用的刺激(广域棒,漂移的巨噬物,或大型移动物体,它们激活传感器的广泛区域,从而只探测粗糙的方向选择性[34,23,63])形成对比.
在这种稀疏的激活下,网络仍然恢复了连续的10 QQ 10 ^{\circ)角估计和速度矢量,而不是粗的八向方向. Sparse激活是局部运动探测器更严格的条件,它也是追踪下游轨迹估计小目标的相关条件,信息信号仅限于少数活动细胞.

blocks.en: A second consideration is how well this perception supports action. The strike policy is deliberately minimal; it commits a flipper whenever the predicted position enters the strike region, with no learned or tuned timing, so the closed-loop outcome depends primarily on the quality of the spiking state estimate rather than on the controller. This is reflected in the action economy of the loop: in the binary-gate regime, it achieved a hit count within the upper part of the human range while issuing far fewer activations than human players of comparable output (Table 4 ). A high hit count obtained from few activations is consistent with position and velocity estimates accurate enough to time individual strikes, whereas noisier estimates would require many speculative activations for the same return, as seen for the more aggressive human players. The loop’s position on the accuracy–economy plane is therefore an indirect indicator of perception quality, although action economy alone does not isolate perception from task difficulty or the specific policy; comparison is made against the range of human performance rather than the group mean, since the small participant pool and varied engagement make the mean an unstable reference.
blocks.zh: 第二个考虑因素是这种看法如何支持行动。 罢工政策是故意的最小化的;每当预测位置进入罢工地区时,它都会进行翻转,没有学习或调制时间,所以闭路结果主要取决于溢出状态估计的质量,而不是控制器. 这体现在循环的动作经济中:在二进制-门机制中,它实现了人类范围上部的命中点数,同时发布的激活量远少于具有可比输出量的人类玩家(表4). 从很少的激活中获得的高命中点数与位置和速度估计值一致,准确到能够给个人撞击时间,而噪声估计值则需要为同样的回报进行许多投机性激活,较激进的人类玩家也看到这一点。 因此,循环在准确度-经济平面上的立场是感知质量的一个间接指标,尽管单靠行动经济并不能将感知与任务困难或具体政策隔离开来;与人类业绩的范围而不是群体含义进行比较,因为参与人数少和参与程度不同使得含义的引用不稳定。

blocks.en: The solid-flipper regime extends this comparison under more realistic contact dynamics, where flippers persist as colliders rather than acting only at the instant of a trigger. Sweeping a single geometric parameter, the size of the strike region, moved the loop continuously across the full range of human strategies observed in the user study, from the low-action, high-precision behaviour of the avoid-misclicks group to the high-action, lower-precision behaviour of the maximise-score group, without any change to the perception pipeline. This is a stronger result than matching a single human operating point, it indicates that the spiking state estimate is accurate enough to support a whole family of viable strike policies, and that the trade-off between precision and activation volume, which for human players reflects a deliberate behavioural strategy, can be reproduced in the closed loop by tuning one interpretable parameter of an otherwise fixed controller. The competitive conversion rates maintained across this sweep further suggest that perception quality, not the decision rule, is what principally bounds performance in both regimes.
blocks.zh: 固滑剂制度在更现实的接触动态下延长了这种比较,在接触动态中,翻转剂作为碰撞剂持续存在,而不是只在触发时才起作用。 扫射一个单一的几何参数,即打击区域的大小,不断将环绕在用户研究中观察到的所有人类策略中,从避免误击组的低动作,高精度行为,到最大分数组的高动作,低精度行为,不改变感知管道. 这比匹配一个人类操作点更强的结果,它表明飞跃状态估计的准确性足以支持一个可行的罢工政策的整个家族,对于人类玩家来说,精度和激活体积之间的权衡反映了一种故意的行为策略,可以通过调试一个原本固定控制器的可解释参数在闭环中复制. 在整个过程中保持的竞争性换算率进一步表明,在两种制度中,认知质量,而不是决策规则,是制约业绩的主要因素。

blocks.en:
The behavioural results are obtained under real-time, low-power operation. The system runs within a bounded latency budget, with an internal network latency of about 5 ​ ms 5\,\mathrm{ms} and an effective reaction time near 21.7 ​ ms 21.7\,\mathrm{ms} once the accumulation window is included, at an estimated dynamic power of ≈ 148 ​ μ ​ W \approx 148\,\mu\mathrm{W} using fewer than 25 25\, k neurons (Section 5.1 ).
The reported power figure corresponds to a worst-case scenario , in which the ball is always present within the field of view, continuously generating DVS events and forcing the neuromorphic pipeline to emit spikes at all stages. This scenario was deliberately chosen to enable a consistent and interpretable estimation of energy consumption. In realistic gameplay conditions, the ball is absent from the region of interest for significant periods, during which the network remains largely inactive and consumes negligible dynamic energy. Therefore, the reported energy consumption should be interpreted as an upper bound.
SpiNNaker is not the lowest-power neuromorphic platform available. Still, its programmability and low-latency spike routing suit a pipeline of this complexity, and its many-core fabric avoids the memory bottleneck of GPU-based implementations [ 17 , 28 ] .
Table 8 situates these figures within the broader landscape of event-based, neuromorphic closed-loop demonstrators. Among the small number of systems that combine spiking perception with neuromorphic computing (See Table 8 , bold examples), the proposed pipeline reports the lowest dynamic power consumption. Direct latency comparison is inherently difficult, as reaction time depends strongly on the dynamics of the game and the specific network design rather than on hardware alone. The only reported latency lower than that of the proposed system is achieved by the table tennis demonstrator of Ziegler et al. [ 82 ] on Akida; however, that system reports only ball position and does not perform velocity estimation. A further interesting latency figure is reported by Gava et al. [ 31 ] , at 8 ​ μ ​ s 8\,\mu\mathrm{s} on a CPU Intel i7; however, this value measures how far behind real time the algorithm’s internal event representation is at the moment of each update, rather than the time required to produce a full position or velocity estimate, and is therefore not directly comparable to the closed-loop reaction time reported here.
Among the systems that combine an event-based camera for perception with neuromorphic computation and closed-loop control (see Table 8 , green and bold examples) [ 3 , 11 , 82 , 58 ] , the proposed pipeline remains competitive in overall reaction time, while being the fastest to jointly estimate the full state vector, position, speed, and direction.
