blocks.en: The quantitative results were obtained in simulation, where the DVS observed an interactive pinball playfield rendered on a monitor, allowing trajectories and ground truth to be controlled and repeated across runs. Within this controlled setting, the nPA loop matched or exceeded human-level hit rates across both flipper regimes while operating within a real-time, low-power budget. To confirm that this behaviour carries over beyond the simulated setting, the loop was additionally deployed on a hardware demonstrator (Section 5 ): a metal ball rolling in a box under ambient lighting, observed by the identical DVS, decoded by the same spiking network, and used to drive servo-actuated flippers in closed loop. This confirms that the pipeline operates on a real scene rather than a rendered one, though as a qualitative demonstration rather than a quantitative one; a full quantitative evaluation on physical hardware remains for future work.
blocks.zh: 在模拟中获得了定量结果,在模拟中,DVS观测到一个交互式弹球播放场在显示器上制造,从而可以控制轨迹和地面的真相,并跨跑重复. 在这种控制环境下,nPA循环在实时、低功率预算范围内运作的同时,在两个翻转系统之间匹配或超过了人的水平命中率。 为了证实这种行为超越模拟设定,循环被额外部署在一个硬件演示器上(第5节):一个金属球在环境照明下在盒子中滚动,由相同的DVS观察,由相同的螺旋网络解码,并用于在闭环中驱动伺服式活性翻转器. 这证实,管道是在真实的场景下运行的,而不是一个已建成的场景,尽管是一种定性的演示而不是定量的演示;对物理硬件的全面定量评价仍然有待今后的工作.

blocks.en: The proposed work points to several natural extensions. The perception pipeline is independent of the striking policy choice, kept minimal to evaluate the perception to action loop, and more capable controllers could be paired with it. In particular, learned policies trained on the decoded ball state would be expected to improve gameplay substantially. Similarly, the current single-scale receptive field is tuned to a specific trade-off between slow- and fast-motion sensitivity (Section 3 ); drawing on the multi-scale organisation of biological visual systems, which combine smaller receptive fields for fine spatial precision with larger ones for fast, coarse motion [ 42 , 57 ] , a comparable multi-scale arrangement would let the model perceive a wider range of motion speeds while improving the precision of motion and velocity estimation. Finally, on the acquisition side, the 60 ​ Hz 60\,\mathrm{Hz} display used in this study imposes a temporal-sampling ceiling on the visual stimulus itself, independent of the network; a higher-refresh-rate display would relax this constraint in future evaluations.
blocks.zh: 拟议的工作涉及若干自然延伸。 感知管道独立于引人注目的政策选择,保持最低程度来评价感知到动作循环,更有能力的控制器可以与之配对. 特别是,在解码球状态方面受过培训的有学问的政策可望大大改进比赛。 同样,目前的单级可接受性领域也适应慢速和快速敏感之间的特定权衡(第3节);利用生物视觉系统的多级组织,将空间精度的较小可接受性领域与速度的较大可接受性领域结合起来,以便快速、粗运动[42、57],一种可比较的多级安排将使模型看到范围更广的运动速度,同时提高运动和速度估计的精度。 最后,在收购方面,60 Hz 60\,\mathrm{ 本研究中使用的Hz}显示对视觉刺激本身施加了时间抽样的上限,独立于网络;更高的再现率显示将缓解未来评价中的这种制约.

blocks.en: In conclusion, these results indicate that a spiking motion-estimation front end coupled to a lightweight decision policy can sustain closed-loop control under the joint latency and energy constraints that challenge frame-based approaches. Here, competitive performance was achieved with fewer than 25 25\, k neurons and sub-milliwatt dynamic power. The presented modular and pipelined architecture provides a blueprint for future neuromorphic systems that must operate under strict power and timing constraints, such as autonomous robotics, human–machine interaction, and adaptive sensorimotor control.
blocks.zh: 总之,这些结果表明,一个尖锐的运动-估计前端加上轻量级决策政策,可以在共同延迟和能量制约下维持闭路控制,从而挑战基于框架的办法。 在此,以不到25 25\,k神经元和次兆瓦的动力实现竞争性性能. 所呈现的模块化和管道化结构为未来的神经形态系统提供了一个蓝图,这些系统必须在严格的动力和时间限制下运作,如自主机器人、人机互动和适应性感官控制。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This work presents a fully characterised, spiking, real-time pipeline for closed-loop neuromorphic perception-to-action pinball gameplay, deployed end-to-end on the SpiNNaker neuromorphic platform. From raw DVS events, the spiking-based pinball (sP) network extracts the ball’s position, speed, and direction entirely through structured spiking computation, with no learned or trained parameters. This state estimate is then converted into flipper commands by a strike decision-making policy.
blocks.zh: 这部作品呈现了完全特征化的,尖锐的,实时的管道,用于闭锁-loop神经形态感知-动作弹珠游戏,在斯皮纳克神经形态平台上部署端到端. 从原始的DVS事件来看,以弹球(sP)网络完全通过结构化的弹出计算来提取球的位置,速度和方向,没有学习过或训练过的参数. 这种状态估计随后通过罢工决策政策转换成翻转命令.

blocks.en:
The network is systematically characterised, and neuromorphic-perception-to-action (nPA) loop performance benchmarked directly against human players across two flipper regimes of increasing physical realism, positioned against prior event-based and neuromorphic closed-loop demonstrators, and validated beyond simulation on a physical demonstrator. Characterisation across receptive field size, accumulation window, and angular tuning width identified 3 × 3 3\times 3 receptive fields, Δ ​ T = 16.7 ​ ms \Delta T=16.7\,\mathrm{ms} , and σ = 30 \sigma=30 as the best configuration for real-time operation.
In the binary-gate regime, the loop reached a hit rate of 56.1 % 56.1\% , almost twice the average human performance and close to the best-performing player, while maintaining a low internal network latency of approximately 5 ​ ms 5\,\mathrm{ms} , an overall reaction latency of 21.7 ​ ms 21.7\,\mathrm{ms} , and sub-milliwatt dynamic power. This performance was achieved with fewer than 25 25\, k neurons and an estimated dynamic power of ≈ 148 ​ μ ​ W \approx 148\,\mu\mathrm{W} , underlining the efficiency of the fully spiking approach.
Whilst in the solid-flipper regime, a single policy parameter drove the nPA loop across the full range of human strategies, from precise to aggressive, with the perception pipeline held fixed. This indicates that the spiking state estimate is accurate enough to support a whole family of viable strike policies, and that closed-loop performance is principally bounded by perception quality rather than policy sophistication. The resulting latency and power figures are further shown to be competitive with, and in several cases superior to, prior event-based and neuromorphic closed-loop demonstrators.
blocks.zh:
网络被系统化地定性,神经形态感知-对动作(nPA)循环性能直接针对人类玩家,跨越两个不断增强的物理现实主义的翻转系统,定位于之前基于事件和神经形态的闭路示威者,并在物理演示器上进行超出模拟的验证. 特性跨越可接受字段大小,积分窗口,角调宽度确定为3×3 3乘3可接受字段,QQ T = 16.7 ms\Delta T = 16.7\,\mathrm{ms},和\ = 30\sigma = 30是实时操作的最佳配置.
在二进制中,循环达到56.1%的命中率56.1\%,几乎是人类平均性能的两倍,并且接近最优秀的玩家,同时保持了低度的内网空位约5ms 5\,\mathrm{ms},总体反应空位为21.7ms 21.7\,\mathrm{ms},和亚米瓦动态功率. 这种性能的实现,不到25\,k神经元和估计的动态功率为 ≈ 148 μ W\ 大约 148\,\ mu\ mathrm{W},强调完全溢出方法的效率.
虽然在固滑系统,但单一的政策参数将nPA循环推向人的全面战略,从精确到激进,并固定了感知管道。 这表明,尖锐的状态估计足够准确,足以支持整个可行的罢工政策,而闭关业务表现主要取决于感知质量,而不是政策复杂程度。 由此产生的延缓和动力数字进一步显示,它们与先前的事件和神经形态的闭路示威者具有竞争力,而且在某些情况下优于示威者。

blocks.en: A physical demonstrator, in which a real metal ball is tracked and physical flippers are actuated in a closed loop, confirmed that the same perception-to-action principle operates beyond simulation. Together, these findings show that fully event-driven, spiking-based computation can match human-level responsiveness in a fast visuomotor task while meeting the stringent latency and energy budgets of real-time operation.
blocks.zh: 一个物理示意图器,其中真实的金属球被跟踪,物理翻转器在闭环中被激活,证实相同的感知对动作原理的操作超出了模拟. 这些调查结果表明,完全由事件驱动的、以跃进为基础的计算可以在快速机动任务中与人的应对能力相匹配,同时满足实时运行的严格延迟和能源预算。

blocks.en:
Several directions remain open for future work. A more compact network, together with alternative kernel sizes and stride configurations, could further reduce the computational load and power demands of the pipeline.
In future work, the system can be extended to embodied robotics by integrating the pipeline with the iCub humanoid platform, enabling real-time sensorimotor control in more complex, three-dimensional interactive environments.
blocks.zh:
今后工作的若干方向仍然开放。 一个更紧凑的网络,加上替代的内核大小和脚步配置,可以进一步减少管道的计算负荷和动力需求.
在未来的工作中,该系统可以通过将管道与iCub人文平台整合,在更为复杂,三维互动的环境中实现实时感应器控制,从而扩展到体现的机器人.
